title: Challenge of the Incas 15 days – Peru Grand Travel

seo.title: Challenge of the Incas 15 days – Peru Grand Travel
seo.description: Discover the fascinating 15-day itinerary in Peru — Cusco, Puno, Lima and Machu Picchu on a guided package with hotels, transfers and expert local guides.

summary: A 15-day Peru itinerary combining the coast, Andes and Lake Titicaca — Cusco, Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Puno and Lima with licensed guides and tailored hotels.
included: Licensed bilingual guide on scheduled excursions
Hotels and domestic transfers per confirmed itinerary
Machu Picchu entrance and train tickets (as per program)
24/7 WhatsApp support from our Cusco team
excluded: Meals not specified in the program
